fallback.name: moon_de440_220930.tf
fallback.reason: Used only if moon_de440_250416.tf cannot be obtained or fails its published size/MD5. NAIF superseded moon_de440_220930.tf with moon_de440_250416.tf and moved it to a_old_versions (its former generic_kernels/fk/satellites URL returns 404, checked 2026-11-09). Its MOON_PA_DE440 and MOON_ME_DE440_ME421 definitions are identical to 250416; only the ID codes of the generic MOON_PA/MOON_ME aliases differ (31010/31011 instead of 31000/31001), and LUNA-OPS never uses those aliases (IB-2, resolved 2026-11-09).

files.evidence: NAIF PDS4 label pub/naif/pds/pds4/clps/clps_spice/spice_kernels/fk/moon_de440_250416.xml (file_size 19,478 bytes, md5 3556dde4bb7ca54a89917c301e650bbf). Located under generic_kernels/fk/satellites (installed from there on 2026-11-08); the CLPS archive URL is kept second.
files.resolved_issue: IB-2 resolved 2026-11-09: moon_de440_250416.tf is the authoritative DE440 lunar frame kernel. NAIF's generic_kernels/fk/satellites/aareadme.txt (revised 2025-04-16) names it as the DE440 FK for moon_pa_de440_200625.bpc, and generic_kernels/fk/satellites holds it while moon_de440_220930.tf is in a_old_versions. NAIF's pck/aareadme.txt (revised 2026-10-03) still names 220930 at its former, now 404, location (out of date). The two kernels define MOON_PA_DE440 and MOON_ME_DE440_ME421 identically: J2000 -> MOON_ME_DE440_ME421 rotations are bitwise identical over 1900-2050. moon_080317.tf stays for the DE421 frames used by V-02e. Evidence: docs/validation_evidence/ib2_2026-11-09/.
